title: Prompted What features should a clinic waiting-room display have?

safeHtmlItem.html:
A good waiting-room display shows:

  • Queue position for each patient
  • Estimated wait time
  • Health tips between updates

Privacy

Use ticket numbers instead of names.

title: Prompted Biker trips: how do I split fuel costs fairly?

safeHtmlItem.html:
Split by distance ridden:

share = total_fuel * rider_km / group_km

Settle up in the app after the ride.

title: Prompted Should the reminder SMS include the doctor's name?

safeHtmlItem.html: Yes, if the patient opted in. Keep the message short & avoid diagnoses.
